title: incident.v1
description: The `incident.yaml` of an incident directory `incidents/<name>/`, beside its executables `inject`, `heal` and optional `probe`. It says what the incident does and to what; it never says what impact is tolerated. ADR-0049.

name.description: Equal to the directory name; unique on the search path. The `incident` label of `sip_chaos_event`.

kind.description: `fault`: acts on a deployed component. `load`: starts a load stream at inject and stops it cleanly at heal.

target.description: The pods the incident acts on. A run profile event may override it.

pick.description: `one`: the executable picks one live pod of the selector (and names it on stdout). `all`: every pod of the selector.

params.description: The incident's parameters. A parameter without `default` must be set by the run profile event.

duration_s.description: The default time between `injected` and `heal`. 0 heals at once (a kill whose recovery is the platform's own).

probe_s.description: How long after `healed` the probe may keep answering not-yet before the event fails.

requires.description: Capabilities the incident needs from the lab (`kind`, `docker`, `chaos-mesh`, …). The runner refuses a profile whose lab lacks one, before the run starts.
